description: Remediation for ISS-009, from the T-011 matrix. Each route already verifies the token ability and organization membership; add the missing policy call so the user's own authorization is checked too, following the pattern established in T-008 ($request->user()?->cannot('update', $server) -> 403). Routes: log-shipping enable/resync/disable, metrics install/probe/thresholds, sites errors retry/remediate. Tests should cover a member of the right org whose workspace role does not permit the server, which is the case org-membership checks let through.
title: Add policy checks to the 8 host-executing API routes
